subject: Kickoff: loss-function guidance for transferable embeddings
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the loss-functions-transfer study. Background: our open-source release showed that loss functions which improve a model's own accuracy often make its features *less* transferable, with checkpoints and SavedModels published for every loss variant. That tension is exactly the trap our embedding teams keep walking into — they tune the training loss for the source task and then wonder why downstream retrieval transfer degrades.

Goal: turn the released models + loss implementations into concrete guidance ("use loss X when the embedding must transfer, loss Y when it's single-task") validated on our own transfer suite.

Milestones: Apr 24 released SavedModels loaded and penultimate-layer features extracted; May 29 transfer evals across our internal task suite; Jun 26 guidance doc + readout.

Alina owns staffing. Yusuf is research lead.

Anders
